review: The hymn is the sufficiency of Christ: 1:1–4 is Isa 53:11 (יִשְׂבַּע) with Ps 16:11, the chorus is Ps 63:2 with 1 Sam 1:15 (שָׁפַךְ נַפְשִׁי) and Phil 4:6, 2:1–4 is 2 Cor 5:7 with Heb 11:1, and 3:1–4 is John 6:31–35 with Deut 8:3 and Ps 121:3.
3:1–2 keep the manna as the name of the gift (הַמָּן), because the stanza is arguing that the One who fed a whole people in the desert is enough for one life.

3:3 וְדָאַגְתָּ אַף לְרַגְלֵיהֶם — the Arabic واهتميت حتى بأقدامهم is 'You cared even for their feet'; the Hebrew uses דָּאַג, the anxious-care verb of 1 Sam 9:5 and Jer 38:19, so the line says attentive providence and not a general kindness.
